key_catalyst: Escalating Houthi attacks on Saudi oil installations and renewed Middle East energy-supply risk
reasoning: Escalating Houthi attacks on Saudi oil installations, with crude returning toward $100 and Treasury yields above 4.69%, represent a high-severity continuation of the oil and inflation shock. Similar developments were followed by QQQ weakness on July 23 and July 24; although a reported US-Iran diplomatic breakthrough and pre-market resilience provide offsets, they do not establish de-escalation. Binary FOMC risk further increases the chance that the market reprices this unresolved catalyst.
